story: The Green Tailed Sunbird (Aethopyga nipalensis) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Nectariniidae family. It is most commonly observed in Temperate forests; subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; open woodland; forest edge; and gardens, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Green Tailed Sunbird is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Green Tailed Sunbird into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
